warmup_policy: First annotation crop per field, repeated before measurements; unseen shapes can incur first-use costs

line_segmentation.foreground: Otsu/border polarity; for bright text, use warm/green chromatic support when >=1% of pixels and >=12% of Otsu support
line_segmentation.close_vertical_gaps: base max(1,floor(height*0.025)); with >=3 bands, bridge up to twice the median of the smaller half of gaps, capped at floor(height/5)
line_segmentation.regions: full-width partitions at midpoints between retained bands; preserve all rows
line_segmentation.layout_verification: All regions are heuristic and unverified; inspect saved overlays

preprocessing.recognizer_resize: Unmodified EasyOCR internal height/aspect-dependent width preprocessing

confidence_method: Character-count-weighted mean of EasyOCR returned region confidences, excluding inserted newlines; empty output has null score
raw_text_assembly: Preserve each returned string; join regions/lines top-to-bottom with actual newlines; no spelling/case/reference correction

timing.preprocessing_ms: File read, SHA-256 check, image decode, RGB/grayscale conversion and line segmentation
timing.recognition_ms: Sum of synchronized wall times around each Reader.recognize call, including internal resize/transfer/forward/decode
timing.crop_total_ms: Wall time for preprocessing, synchronized recognition and result assembly
timing.excluded: Model initialization, warmups, preflight/integrity hashing, previews and result-file writes
timing.percentile: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*q across successful heterogeneous crops, separately by set/field

summary.timing_population: successful crops only; error counts and individual error times retained
